articles.headline: Oil Surges Past $100 Amid US-Iran Conflict
articles.whyItMatters: Escalating Middle East conflict threatens global energy supplies and stokes inflationary pressures worldwide.
articles.brief: Crude oil surpassed $100 a barrel following intense tit-for-tat strikes between the US and Iran, exposing a dwindling safety net for global energy markets.

articles.headline: Apple Unveils First Foldable iPhone Duo
articles.whyItMatters: Apple officially enters the lucrative foldable device market, challenging competitors with a high-end passport-shaped design.
articles.brief: Apple revealed its long-awaited passport-shaped foldable phone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro lineup during its major showcase.

articles.headline: Ukraine Strikes Russian Arctic Gas Plants
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates the expanding range of Ukrainian long-range strikes targeting critical Russian energy infrastructure.
articles.brief: Ukraine successfully struck two gas condensate processing plants in Russia’s Arctic zone for the first time, hitting key industrial targets.

articles.headline: Philippines Ferry Fire Leaves Five Dead
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights ongoing maritime safety concerns and passenger vessel vulnerabilities in regional waters.
articles.brief: A devastating fire aboard a passenger ferry in the Philippines left five people dead and dozens missing as rescue operations continued.

articles.headline: UN Watchdog Censure Deepens Iran Impasse
articles.whyItMatters: Escalates international diplomatic friction and refers Iran's nuclear file directly to the UN Security Council.
articles.brief: The US successfully pushed through a UN watchdog resolution censuring Iran, widening the diplomatic divide between Western nations, Beijing, and Moscow.

articles.headline: India Serious Fraud Office Probes Xiaomi
articles.whyItMatters: Signals mounting regulatory scrutiny for major foreign technology manufacturers operating within the Indian market.
articles.brief: India's Serious Fraud Office recommended a detailed investigation into Xiaomi's business operations within the country amid ongoing compliance reviews.

articles.headline: Apple Delays Hypertension Alert Feature in India
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates the strict regulatory approval hurdles wearable health tech manufacturers face in key emerging markets.
articles.brief: Apple delayed the launch of the hypertension notification feature on its Watch Series 12 in India pending local regulatory clearances.

articles.headline: International Space Summit Opens in Paris
articles.whyItMatters: Brings together global leaders to forge multi-billion-dollar aerospace partnerships and collaborative space exploration projects.
articles.brief: The International Space Summit kicked off in Paris with delegates from 90 countries slated to sign over 50 major investment projects.
